{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.54

|arg= global

|eff= global

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Set the material of the given selection on all computers in a network session.

|s1= obj [[setObjectMaterialGlobal]] [selection, material]

|p1= obj: [[Object]]

|p2= selection: [[Number]] or {{GVI|arma3|2.10|size= 0.75}} [[String]]

|p3= material: [[String]] - material path. Since {{GVI|arma3|2.20}} using '''"#reset"''' would reset to default material.

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>player setObjectMaterialGlobal [0, "A3\Structures_F\Data\Windows\window_set.rvmat"];</sqf>

|seealso= [[setObjectTexture]] [[setObjectTextureGlobal]] [[getObjectTextures]] [[setObjectMaterial]] [[getObjectMaterials]]
}}
